classification.difficultyReason: Use the fixed volume to eliminate height from the surface-area formula.

content.prompt:
A closed cylindrical tin can is to hold 500 cm³ of food.
Let the radius of the base be $r$ cm.
Show that the total surface area is $S=2\pi r^2+\frac{1000}{r}$.

spec.description: Unlabelled upright cylinder with a complete elliptical top, two vertical silhouette edges and the visible lower half of the bottom ellipse. No hidden edges or shading.
spec.mathematics: Closed circular cylinder; radius and capacity are given in the prompt.

answer.worked:
Let the height be $h$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}
\pi r^2h&=500\\
h&=\frac{500}{\pi r^2}
\end{align*}$$
The closed can has two circular ends and a curved surface.
$$\begin{align*}
S&=2\pi r^2+2\pi rh\\
S&=2\pi r^2+2\pi r\left(\frac{500}{\pi r^2}\right)\\
S&=2\pi r^2+\frac{1000}{r}\text{ cm}^2.
\end{align*}$$
